entities.summary: Myint Swe was a Burmese politician and army officer who was Vice President of Myanmar from 30 March 2016, and Acting President of Myanmar from 1 February 2021 until his death in 2025, though withdrawing for health reasons on 22 July 2024. He also served as the acting president from 21 March 2018 to 30 March 2018 after the resignation of President Htin Kyaw, and the chief minister of Yangon Region from 30 March 2011 to 30 March 2016. A member of the military proxy Union Solidarity and Development Party, he was an ethnic Mon and a lieutenant general in the Myanmar Army.
